229	    async def _preprocess_reward_inputs(self, data: DataProto) -> str:
230	        assert len(data) == 1, "RewardLoopWorker only support single data item"
231	        data_item = data[0]
232	        assert "raw_prompt" in data_item.non_tensor_batch
233	
234	        # extract raw prompt
235	        chat: list = list(data_item.non_tensor_batch["raw_prompt"])
236	
237	        # extract response
238	        response_ids = data_item.batch["responses"]
239	        response_length = response_ids.shape[-1]
240	        valid_response_length = data_item.batch["attention_mask"][-response_length:].sum()
241	        valid_response_ids = response_ids[:valid_response_length]
242	
243	        rollout_response = self.input_tokenizer.decode(valid_response_ids)
244	        rollout_response = rollout_response.replace(self.input_tokenizer.eos_token, "")
245	
246	        chat.append({"role": "assistant", "content": rollout_response})
247	
248	        rm_prompt = self.reward_model_tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
249	            chat,
250	            add_generation_prompt=False,
251	            tokenize=False,
252	        )
253	
254	        # llama tokenizer will add bos token by default
255	        # will be removed in vllm >= 0.11.2, where we can add "add_special_tokens" = False
256	        if self.reward_model_tokenizer.bos_token is not None and rm_prompt.startswith(
257	            self.reward_model_tokenizer.bos_token

261	        return rm_prompt

263	    async def compute_score_disrm(self, data: DataProto) -> dict:
264	        disrm_prompt = await self._preprocess_reward_inputs(data)
265	        engine_name = self.config.reward.reward_model.rollout.name
266	        model_name = self.config.reward.reward_model.model_path
267	        if engine_name == "vllm":
268	            payloads = {
269	                "model": model_name,
270	                "input": disrm_prompt,
271	                "use_activation": False,
272	            }
273	            output = await self._post_request(payloads, "classify")
274	            rm_score = output["data"][-1]["probs"][-1]
275	        elif engine_name == "sglang":
276	            payloads = {
277	                "model": model_name,
278	                "input": disrm_prompt,
279	            }
280	            output = await self._post_request(payloads, "v1/embeddings")
281	            rm_score = output["data"][-1]["embedding"][-1]
282	        elif engine_name == "trtllm":
283	            # TODO: remove this once TRT-LLM switches to TorchSampler
284	            raise ValueError("TensorRT-LLM backend does not support reward models currently.")
285	
286	            payloads = {
287	                "model": model_name,
288	                "prompt": disrm_prompt,
289	                "return_context_logits": True,
290	            }
291	            output = await self._post_request(payloads, "v1/completions")
292	            rm_score = output["choices"][0]["context_logits"]
293	            assert isinstance(rm_score, list) and len(rm_score) > 0, (
294	                "TensorRT-LLM OpenAI server response for reward score is not in the expected format."
295	            )
296	
297	            rm_score = float(rm_score[0][0])
298	            logger.debug(f"rm score: {rm_score}")
299	        else:
300	            raise NotImplementedError(f"RewardLoopManager does not support {engine_name}")
301	
302	        return {"reward_score": rm_score}

305	class RewardLoopManager:
306	    """
307	    RewardLoopManager run in single controller.
308	    This class will create reward loop workers and manage them.
309	    """
310	
311	    def __init__(self, config: DictConfig, rm_resource_pool: RayResourcePool = None):
312	        self.config = config
313	        if self.config.reward.reward_model.enable:
314	            self.reward_model_manager = RewardModelManager(config.reward.reward_model, rm_resource_pool)
315	            self.reward_router_address = self.reward_model_manager.get_router_address()
316	        else:
317	            self.reward_model_manager = None
318	            self.reward_router_address = None
319	
320	        self.reward_loop_workers_class = ray.remote(RewardLoopWorker)
321	        self.reward_manager_cls = resolve_reward_manager_cls(config)
322	        self._init_reward_loop_workers()
323	
324	    @property
325	    def reward_loop_worker_handles(self) -> list[ActorHandle]:
326	        """Return worker handles for agent loop worker to compute reward score.
327	
328	        Only return worker handles when reward computation can be parallelized with rollout:
329	        (1) rule-based reward without reward model
330	        (2) reward model with extra resource pool
331	        """
332	        if not self.config.reward.reward_model.enable or self.config.reward.reward_model.enable_resource_pool:
333	            return self.reward_loop_workers
334	        return None
335	
336	    def _init_reward_loop_workers(self):
337	        self.reward_loop_workers = []
338	        num_workers = self.config.reward.num_workers
339	        node_ids = [node["NodeID"] for node in ray.nodes() if node["Alive"] and node["Resources"].get("CPU", 0) > 0]
340	
341	        for i in range(num_workers):
342	            # Round-robin scheduling over the all nodes
343	            node_id = node_ids[i % len(node_ids)]
344	
345	            self.reward_loop_workers.append(
346	                self.reward_loop_workers_class.options(
347	                    name=f"reward_loop_worker_{i}",
348	                    scheduling_strategy=ray.util.scheduling_strategies.NodeAffinitySchedulingStrategy(
349	                        node_id=node_id,
350	                        soft=True,
351	                    ),
352	                ).remote(self.config, self.reward_router_address)
353	            )
354	
355	    def compute_rm_score(self, data: DataProto) -> DataProto:
356	        if self.reward_model_manager is not None:
357	            self.reward_model_manager.wake_up()
358	
359	        num_workers = len(self.reward_loop_workers)
360	        padded_data, pad_size = pad_dataproto_to_divisor(data, num_workers)
361	        chunks = padded_data.chunk(num_workers)
362	        outputs = ray.get(
363	            [
364	                worker.compute_score_batch.remote(chunk)
365	                for worker, chunk in zip(self.reward_loop_workers, chunks, strict=True)
366	            ]
367	        )
368	        outputs_flat = [item for sublist in outputs for item in sublist]
369	        if pad_size > 0:
370	            outputs_flat = outputs_flat[: len(data)]
371	
372	        # compute rm score
373	        scores = [item["reward_score"] for item in outputs_flat]
374	        rm_scores = self.reward_manager_cls.assemble_rm_scores(data, scores)
375	        batch = TensorDict({"rm_scores": rm_scores}, batch_size=len(data))
376	
377	        reward_extra_infos = [output.get("reward_extra_info", {}) for output in outputs_flat]
378	        reward_extra_keys = list(reward_extra_infos[0].keys())
379	        non_tensor_batch = {}
380	        for key in reward_extra_keys:
381	            non_tensor_batch[key] = np.array([info[key] for info in reward_extra_infos], dtype=object)
382	
383	        if self.reward_model_manager is not None:
384	            self.reward_model_manager.sleep()
385	
386	        return DataProto(
387	            batch=batch, non_tensor_batch=non_tensor_batch, meta_info={"reward_extra_keys": reward_extra_keys}
388	        )
389	
390	    def _run_all(self, tasks: list[asyncio.Task]):
391	        async def run_all():
392	            return await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
393	
394	        return asyncio.run(run_all())

import asyncio
import logging
import os

import aiohttp
import numpy as np
import ray
from omegaconf import DictConfig, open_dict
from ray.actor import ActorHandle
from tensordict import TensorDict

from verl.protocol import DataProto, pad_dataproto_to_divisor
from verl.single_controller.ray.base import RayResourcePool
from verl.trainer.ppo.reward import load_reward_manager, resolve_reward_manager_cls
from verl.utils import hf_tokenizer
from verl.utils.fs import copy_to_local
from verl.utils.ray_utils import get_event_loop

from .reward_model import RewardModelManager

logger = logging.getLogger(__file__)
logger.setLevel(os.getenv("VERL_LOGGING_LEVEL", "WARN"))


def migrate_legacy_reward_impl(config):
    """
    Migrate the legacy reward model implementation to the new one.
    """
    # 1. reward workers migration
    # config.reward_model.num_workers -> config.reward.num_workers
    if config.reward_model.num_workers is not None:
        config.reward.num_workers = config.reward_model.num_workers

    # 2. reward manager migration
    # config.reward_model.reward_manager -> config.reward.reward_manager
    if config.reward_model.reward_manager is not None:
        config.reward.reward_manager.name = config.reward_model.reward_manager
    if config.reward_model.reward_loop_source is not None:
        config.reward.reward_manager.source = config.reward_model.reward_loop_source
        config.reward.reward_manager.module.path = config.reward_model.reward_loop_module_path
        config.reward.reward_manager.module.name = config.reward_model.reward_loop_class_name

    # 3. custom reward function migration
    # config.custom_reward_function -> config.reward.custom_reward_function
    if not all(v is None for v in config.custom_reward_function.values()):
        config.reward.custom_reward_function = config.custom_reward_function

    # 4. reward model migration
    # config.reward_model -> config.reward.reward_model
    for key in ["enable", "enable_resource_pool", "n_gpus_per_node", "nnodes"]:
        if config.reward_model.get(key) is not None:
            config.reward.reward_model[key] = config.reward_model[key]
    if config.reward_model.model.path is not None:
        config.reward.reward_model.model_path = config.reward_model.model.path
    # config.reward_model.reward_kwargs -> config.reward.reward_kwargs (for dapo algo)
    if config.reward_model.get("reward_kwargs") is not None:
        with open_dict(config.reward):
            config.reward["reward_kwargs"] = config.reward_model["reward_kwargs"]
    # config.reward_model.rollout -> config.reward.reward_model.rollout
    legacy_rollout = config.reward_model.rollout
    for key in legacy_rollout.keys():
        if legacy_rollout[key] is not None:
            config.reward.reward_model.rollout[key] = legacy_rollout[key]

    # 5. sandbox_fusion migration
    # config.sandbox_fusion -> reward.sandbox_fusion
    if not all(v is None for v in config.sandbox_fusion.values()):
        config.reward.sandbox_fusion = config.sandbox_fusion

    # 6. delete legacy config from configs
    with open_dict(config):
        del config.reward_model
        del config.custom_reward_function
        del config.sandbox_fusion

    return config


class RewardLoopWorker:
    """
    RewardLoopWork can tackle reward computation:
    (1) rule-based reward computation
    (2) reward model-based reward computation (both disrm and genrm)
    (3) high-flexible user-customized reward function (can access rm by posting requests to reward_model_router)

    Reward Computation Logic:
    - if user-customized reward function is provided:
        -> directly use user-customized reward function
    - if user-customized reward function is not provided:
        -> rm is not enabled: use default rule-based reward function
        -> rm is disrm: compute reward score using disrm
        -> rm is genrm: raise error (user-costomized reward func must be provided)
    """

    def __init__(self, config: DictConfig, reward_router_address: str = None):
        """
        Args:
            config: DictConfig, the config for reward loop worker.
            reward_router_address: str, the address of reward router.
        """
        self.config = config
        self.reward_router_address = reward_router_address
        self._init_reward_fn()
        self.loop = get_event_loop()

    def _init_reward_fn(self):
        input_tokenizer_path = self.config.actor_rollout_ref.model.tokenizer_path
        if input_tokenizer_path is None:
            input_tokenizer_path = self.config.actor_rollout_ref.model.path
        input_tokenizer_local_path = copy_to_local(input_tokenizer_path)
        self.input_tokenizer = hf_tokenizer(input_tokenizer_local_path, trust_remote_code=True)
        self.reward_model_tokenizer = None
        if self.config.reward.reward_model.enable:
            reward_model_tokenizer_local_path = copy_to_local(self.config.reward.reward_model.model_path)
            self.reward_model_tokenizer = hf_tokenizer(reward_model_tokenizer_local_path, trust_remote_code=True)

        self.reward_manager = load_reward_manager(
            self.config,
            self.input_tokenizer,
            reward_router_address=self.reward_router_address,
            reward_model_tokenizer=self.reward_model_tokenizer,
        )

    def reinit_reward_fn(self, swapped_rels: list[str] | None = None) -> dict:
        """
        Bench: after baseline files are pasted/restored on disk, drop cached
        modules and rebuild reward_manager so validate uses sealed code.
        """
        try:
            from verl.utils.bench_baseline_swap import purge_modules_for_rels

            if swapped_rels:
                purge_modules_for_rels(list(swapped_rels))
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("bench purge_modules failed: %s", e)

        # Prefer fresh load_reward_manager from (possibly swapped) reward.py
        try:
            import importlib

            import verl.trainer.ppo.reward as reward_mod

            importlib.reload(reward_mod)
            load_fn = reward_mod.load_reward_manager
        except Exception:
            load_fn = load_reward_manager

        self.reward_manager = load_fn(
            self.config,
            self.input_tokenizer,
            reward_router_address=self.reward_router_address,
            reward_model_tokenizer=self.reward_model_tokenizer,
        )
        return {"ok": True, "swapped_rels": list(swapped_rels or [])}

    async def compute_score_batch(self, data: DataProto) -> list[dict]:
        tasks = []
        for i in range(len(data)):
            tasks.append(asyncio.create_task(self.compute_score(data[i : i + 1])))
        outputs = await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
        return outputs

    async def compute_score(self, data: DataProto) -> dict:
        if self.config.reward.custom_reward_function.path is not None:
            # directly use user-customized reward function
            return await self.reward_manager.run_single(data)
        else:
            if self.config.reward.reward_model.enable:
                # we assume the rm is disrm
                # genrm must set custom_reward_function
                return await self.compute_score_disrm(data[-1:])
            else:
                return await self.reward_manager.run_single(data)

    async def _post_request(self, payload: dict, endpoint: str, max_retries: int = 16):
        url = f"http://{self.reward_router_address}/{endpoint}"
        last_exception = None
        for attempt in range(max_retries):
            try:
                # It's safer to have a timeout instead of None, which can hang indefinitely.
                timeout = aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=None)
                async with aiohttp.ClientSession(timeout=timeout) as session:
                    async with session.post(url, json=payload) as resp:
                        resp.raise_for_status()
                        return await resp.json()
            except aiohttp.ClientResponseError as e:
                # Do not retry on 4xx client errors, but retry on 5xx server errors.
                if 400 <= e.status < 500:
                    logger.error(f"Request to {url} failed with client error HTTP {e.status}: {e}. Not retrying.")
                    raise
                last_exception = e
                logger.warning(
                    f"[Attempt {attempt + 1}/{max_retries}] Request to {url} failed with HTTP {e.status}: {e}. "
                    "Retrying..."
                )
            except (asyncio.TimeoutError, aiohttp.ClientConnectorError) as e:
                last_exception = e
                logger.warning(f"[Attempt {attempt + 1}/{max_retries}] Request to {url} failed: {e}. Retrying...")
            except Exception as e:
                last_exception = e
                logger.warning(
                    f"[Attempt {attempt + 1}/{max_retries}] Request to {url} failed with unexpected error: {e}. "
                    "Retrying..."
                )

            if attempt < max_retries - 1:
                # Using exponential backoff is generally better than a fixed sleep.
                backoff_seconds = 2**attempt
                await asyncio.sleep(min(backoff_seconds, 30))

        logger.error(f"Max retries ({max_retries}) reached for request to {url}.")
        if last_exception:
            raise last_exception

    async def _preprocess_reward_inputs(self, data: DataProto) -> str:
        assert len(data) == 1, "RewardLoopWorker only support single data item"
        data_item = data[0]
        assert "raw_prompt" in data_item.non_tensor_batch

        # extract raw prompt
        chat: list = list(data_item.non_tensor_batch["raw_prompt"])

        # extract response
        response_ids = data_item.batch["responses"]
        response_length = response_ids.shape[-1]
        valid_response_length = data_item.batch["attention_mask"][-response_length:].sum()
        valid_response_ids = response_ids[:valid_response_length]

        rollout_response = self.input_tokenizer.decode(valid_response_ids)
        rollout_response = rollout_response.replace(self.input_tokenizer.eos_token, "")

        chat.append({"role": "assistant", "content": rollout_response})

        rm_prompt = self.reward_model_tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
            chat,
            add_generation_prompt=False,
            tokenize=False,
        )

        # llama tokenizer will add bos token by default
        # will be removed in vllm >= 0.11.2, where we can add "add_special_tokens" = False
        if self.reward_model_tokenizer.bos_token is not None and rm_prompt.startswith(
            self.reward_model_tokenizer.bos_token
        ):
            rm_prompt = rm_prompt[len(self.reward_model_tokenizer.bos_token) :]

        return rm_prompt

    async def compute_score_disrm(self, data: DataProto) -> dict:
        disrm_prompt = await self._preprocess_reward_inputs(data)
        engine_name = self.config.reward.reward_model.rollout.name
        model_name = self.config.reward.reward_model.model_path
        if engine_name == "vllm":
            payloads = {
                "model": model_name,
                "input": disrm_prompt,
                "use_activation": False,
            }
            output = await self._post_request(payloads, "classify")
            rm_score = output["data"][-1]["probs"][-1]
        elif engine_name == "sglang":
            payloads = {
                "model": model_name,
                "input": disrm_prompt,
            }
            output = await self._post_request(payloads, "v1/embeddings")
            rm_score = output["data"][-1]["embedding"][-1]
        elif engine_name == "trtllm":
            # TODO: remove this once TRT-LLM switches to TorchSampler
            raise ValueError("TensorRT-LLM backend does not support reward models currently.")

            payloads = {
                "model": model_name,
                "prompt": disrm_prompt,
                "return_context_logits": True,
            }
            output = await self._post_request(payloads, "v1/completions")
            rm_score = output["choices"][0]["context_logits"]
            assert isinstance(rm_score, list) and len(rm_score) > 0, (
                "TensorRT-LLM OpenAI server response for reward score is not in the expected format."
            )

            rm_score = float(rm_score[0][0])
            logger.debug(f"rm score: {rm_score}")
        else:
            raise NotImplementedError(f"RewardLoopManager does not support {engine_name}")

        return {"reward_score": rm_score}


class RewardLoopManager:
    """
    RewardLoopManager run in single controller.
    This class will create reward loop workers and manage them.
    """

    def __init__(self, config: DictConfig, rm_resource_pool: RayResourcePool = None):
        self.config = config
        if self.config.reward.reward_model.enable:
            self.reward_model_manager = RewardModelManager(config.reward.reward_model, rm_resource_pool)
            self.reward_router_address = self.reward_model_manager.get_router_address()
        else:
            self.reward_model_manager = None
            self.reward_router_address = None

        self.reward_loop_workers_class = ray.remote(RewardLoopWorker)
        self.reward_manager_cls = resolve_reward_manager_cls(config)
        self._init_reward_loop_workers()

    @property
    def reward_loop_worker_handles(self) -> list[ActorHandle]:
        """Return worker handles for agent loop worker to compute reward score.

        Only return worker handles when reward computation can be parallelized with rollout:
        (1) rule-based reward without reward model
        (2) reward model with extra resource pool
        """
        if not self.config.reward.reward_model.enable or self.config.reward.reward_model.enable_resource_pool:
            return self.reward_loop_workers
        return None

    def _init_reward_loop_workers(self):
        self.reward_loop_workers = []
        num_workers = self.config.reward.num_workers
        node_ids = [node["NodeID"] for node in ray.nodes() if node["Alive"] and node["Resources"].get("CPU", 0) > 0]

        for i in range(num_workers):
            # Round-robin scheduling over the all nodes
            node_id = node_ids[i % len(node_ids)]

            self.reward_loop_workers.append(
                self.reward_loop_workers_class.options(
                    name=f"reward_loop_worker_{i}",
                    scheduling_strategy=ray.util.scheduling_strategies.NodeAffinitySchedulingStrategy(
                        node_id=node_id,
                        soft=True,
                    ),
                ).remote(self.config, self.reward_router_address)
            )

    def compute_rm_score(self, data: DataProto) -> DataProto:
        if self.reward_model_manager is not None:
            self.reward_model_manager.wake_up()

        num_workers = len(self.reward_loop_workers)
        padded_data, pad_size = pad_dataproto_to_divisor(data, num_workers)
        chunks = padded_data.chunk(num_workers)
        outputs = ray.get(
            [
                worker.compute_score_batch.remote(chunk)
                for worker, chunk in zip(self.reward_loop_workers, chunks, strict=True)
            ]
        )
        outputs_flat = [item for sublist in outputs for item in sublist]
        if pad_size > 0:
            outputs_flat = outputs_flat[: len(data)]

        # compute rm score
        scores = [item["reward_score"] for item in outputs_flat]
        rm_scores = self.reward_manager_cls.assemble_rm_scores(data, scores)
        batch = TensorDict({"rm_scores": rm_scores}, batch_size=len(data))

        reward_extra_infos = [output.get("reward_extra_info", {}) for output in outputs_flat]
        reward_extra_keys = list(reward_extra_infos[0].keys())
        non_tensor_batch = {}
        for key in reward_extra_keys:
            non_tensor_batch[key] = np.array([info[key] for info in reward_extra_infos], dtype=object)

        if self.reward_model_manager is not None:
            self.reward_model_manager.sleep()

        return DataProto(
            batch=batch, non_tensor_batch=non_tensor_batch, meta_info={"reward_extra_keys": reward_extra_keys}
        )

    def _run_all(self, tasks: list[asyncio.Task]):
        async def run_all():
            return await asyncio.gather(*tasks)

        return asyncio.run(run_all())

42	    """
43	    # 1. reward workers migration
44	    # config.reward_model.num_workers -> config.reward.num_workers
45	    if config.reward_model.num_workers is not None:
46	        config.reward.num_workers = config.reward_model.num_workers
47	
48	    # 2. reward manager migration
49	    # config.reward_model.reward_manager -> config.reward.reward_manager
50	    if config.reward_model.reward_manager is not None:
51	        config.reward.reward_manager.name = config.reward_model.reward_manager
52	    if config.reward_model.reward_loop_source is not None:
53	        config.reward.reward_manager.source = config.reward_model.reward_loop_source
54	        config.reward.reward_manager.module.path = config.reward_model.reward_loop_module_path
55	        config.reward.reward_manager.module.name = config.reward_model.reward_loop_class_name
56	
57	    # 3. custom reward function migration
58	    # config.custom_reward_function -> config.reward.custom_reward_function
59	    if not all(v is None for v in config.custom_reward_function.values()):
60	        config.reward.custom_reward_function = config.custom_reward_function
61	
62	    # 4. reward model migration
63	    # config.reward_model -> config.reward.reward_model
64	    for key in ["enable", "enable_resource_pool", "n_gpus_per_node", "nnodes"]:
65	        if config.reward_model.get(key) is not None:
66	            config.reward.reward_model[key] = config.reward_model[key]
67	    if config.reward_model.model.path is not None:
68	        config.reward.reward_model.model_path = config.reward_model.model.path
69	    # config.reward_model.reward_kwargs -> config.reward.reward_kwargs (for dapo algo)
70	    if config.reward_model.get("reward_kwargs") is not None:
71	        with open_dict(config.reward):
72	            config.reward["reward_kwargs"] = config.reward_model["reward_kwargs"]
73	    # config.reward_model.rollout -> config.reward.reward_model.rollout
74	    legacy_rollout = config.reward_model.rollout
75	    for key in legacy_rollout.keys():
76	        if legacy_rollout[key] is not None:
77	            config.reward.reward_model.rollout[key] = legacy_rollout[key]
78	
79	    # 5. sandbox_fusion migration
80	    # config.sandbox_fusion -> reward.sandbox_fusion
81	    if not all(v is None for v in config.sandbox_fusion.values()):
82	        config.reward.sandbox_fusion = config.sandbox_fusion
83	
84	    # 6. delete legacy config from configs
85	    with open_dict(config):
86	        del config.reward_model
87	        del config.custom_reward_function
88	        del config.sandbox_fusion
89	
90	    return config

93	class RewardLoopWorker:
94	    """
95	    RewardLoopWork can tackle reward computation:
96	    (1) rule-based reward computation
97	    (2) reward model-based reward computation (both disrm and genrm)
98	    (3) high-flexible user-customized reward function (can access rm by posting requests to reward_model_router)
99	
100	    Reward Computation Logic:
101	    - if user-customized reward function is provided:
102	        -> directly use user-customized reward function
103	    - if user-customized reward function is not provided:
104	        -> rm is not enabled: use default rule-based reward function
105	        -> rm is disrm: compute reward score using disrm
106	        -> rm is genrm: raise error (user-costomized reward func must be provided)
107	    """
108	
109	    def __init__(self, config: DictConfig, reward_router_address: str = None):
110	        """
111	        Args:
112	            config: DictConfig, the config for reward loop worker.
113	            reward_router_address: str, the address of reward router.
114	        """
115	        self.config = config
116	        self.reward_router_address = reward_router_address
117	        self._init_reward_fn()
118	        self.loop = get_event_loop()
119	
120	    def _init_reward_fn(self):
121	        input_tokenizer_path = self.config.actor_rollout_ref.model.tokenizer_path
122	        if input_tokenizer_path is None:
123	            input_tokenizer_path = self.config.actor_rollout_ref.model.path
124	        input_tokenizer_local_path = copy_to_local(input_tokenizer_path)
125	        self.input_tokenizer = hf_tokenizer(input_tokenizer_local_path, trust_remote_code=True)
126	        self.reward_model_tokenizer = None
127	        if self.config.reward.reward_model.enable:
128	            reward_model_tokenizer_local_path = copy_to_local(self.config.reward.reward_model.model_path)
129	            self.reward_model_tokenizer = hf_tokenizer(reward_model_tokenizer_local_path, trust_remote_code=True)
130	
131	        self.reward_manager = load_reward_manager(
132	            self.config,
133	            self.input_tokenizer,
134	            reward_router_address=self.reward_router_address,
135	            reward_model_tokenizer=self.reward_model_tokenizer,
136	        )
137	
138	    def reinit_reward_fn(self, swapped_rels: list[str] | None = None) -> dict:
139	        """
140	        Bench: after baseline files are pasted/restored on disk, drop cached
141	        modules and rebuild reward_manager so validate uses sealed code.
142	        """
143	        try:
144	            from verl.utils.bench_baseline_swap import purge_modules_for_rels
145	
146	            if swapped_rels:
147	                purge_modules_for_rels(list(swapped_rels))
148	        except Exception as e:
149	            logger.warning("bench purge_modules failed: %s", e)
150	
151	        # Prefer fresh load_reward_manager from (possibly swapped) reward.py
152	        try:
153	            import importlib
154	
155	            import verl.trainer.ppo.reward as reward_mod
156	
157	            importlib.reload(reward_mod)
158	            load_fn = reward_mod.load_reward_manager
159	        except Exception:
160	            load_fn = load_reward_manager
161	
162	        self.reward_manager = load_fn(
163	            self.config,
164	            self.input_tokenizer,
165	            reward_router_address=self.reward_router_address,
166	            reward_model_tokenizer=self.reward_model_tokenizer,
167	        )
168	        return {"ok": True, "swapped_rels": list(swapped_rels or [])}
169	
170	    async def compute_score_batch(self, data: DataProto) -> list[dict]:
171	        tasks = []
172	        for i in range(len(data)):
173	            tasks.append(asyncio.create_task(self.compute_score(data[i : i + 1])))
174	        outputs = await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
175	        return outputs
176	
177	    async def compute_score(self, data: DataProto) -> dict:
178	        if self.config.reward.custom_reward_function.path is not None:
179	            # directly use user-customized reward function
180	            return await self.reward_manager.run_single(data)
181	        else:
182	            if self.config.reward.reward_model.enable:
183	                # we assume the rm is disrm
184	                # genrm must set custom_reward_function
185	                return await self.compute_score_disrm(data[-1:])
186	            else:
187	                return await self.reward_manager.run_single(data)
188	
189	    async def _post_request(self, payload: dict, endpoint: str, max_retries: int = 16):
190	        url = f"http://{self.reward_router_address}/{endpoint}"
191	        last_exception = None
192	        for attempt in range(max_retries):
193	            try:
194	                # It's safer to have a timeout instead of None, which can hang indefinitely.
195	                timeout = aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=None)
196	                async with aiohttp.ClientSession(timeout=timeout) as session:
197	                    async with session.post(url, json=payload) as resp:
198	                        resp.raise_for_status()
199	                        return await resp.json()
200	            except aiohttp.ClientResponseError as e:
201	                # Do not retry on 4xx client errors, but retry on 5xx server errors.
202	                if 400 <= e.status < 500:
203	                    logger.error(f"Request to {url} failed with client error HTTP {e.status}: {e}. Not retrying.")
204	                    raise
205	                last_exception = e
206	                logger.warning(
207	                    f"[Attempt {attempt + 1}/{max_retries}] Request to {url} failed with HTTP {e.status}: {e}. "
208	                    "Retrying..."
209	                )
210	            except (asyncio.TimeoutError, aiohttp.ClientConnectorError) as e:
211	                last_exception = e
212	                logger.warning(f"[Attempt {attempt + 1}/{max_retries}] Request to {url} failed: {e}. Retrying...")
213	            except Exception as e:
214	                last_exception = e
215	                logger.warning(
216	                    f"[Attempt {attempt + 1}/{max_retries}] Request to {url} failed with unexpected error: {e}. "
217	                    "Retrying..."
218	                )
219	
220	            if attempt < max_retries - 1:
221	                # Using exponential backoff is generally better than a fixed sleep.
222	                backoff_seconds = 2**attempt
223	                await asyncio.sleep(min(backoff_seconds, 30))
224	
225	        logger.error(f"Max retries ({max_retries}) reached for request to {url}.")
226	        if last_exception:
227	            raise last_exception
228	
229	    async def _preprocess_reward_inputs(self, data: DataProto) -> str:
230	        assert len(data) == 1, "RewardLoopWorker only support single data item"
231	        data_item = data[0]
232	        assert "raw_prompt" in data_item.non_tensor_batch
233	
234	        # extract raw prompt
235	        chat: list = list(data_item.non_tensor_batch["raw_prompt"])
236	
237	        # extract response
238	        response_ids = data_item.batch["responses"]
239	        response_length = response_ids.shape[-1]
240	        valid_response_length = data_item.batch["attention_mask"][-response_length:].sum()
241	        valid_response_ids = response_ids[:valid_response_length]
242	
243	        rollout_response = self.input_tokenizer.decode(valid_response_ids)
244	        rollout_response = rollout_response.replace(self.input_tokenizer.eos_token, "")
245	
246	        chat.append({"role": "assistant", "content": rollout_response})
247	
248	        rm_prompt = self.reward_model_tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
249	            chat,
250	            add_generation_prompt=False,
251	            tokenize=False,
252	        )
253	
254	        # llama tokenizer will add bos token by default
255	        # will be removed in vllm >= 0.11.2, where we can add "add_special_tokens" = False
256	        if self.reward_model_tokenizer.bos_token is not None and rm_prompt.startswith(
257	            self.reward_model_tokenizer.bos_token
258	        ):
259	            rm_prompt = rm_prompt[len(self.reward_model_tokenizer.bos_token) :]
260	
261	        return rm_prompt
262	
263	    async def compute_score_disrm(self, data: DataProto) -> dict:
264	        disrm_prompt = await self._preprocess_reward_inputs(data)
265	        engine_name = self.config.reward.reward_model.rollout.name
266	        model_name = self.config.reward.reward_model.model_path
267	        if engine_name == "vllm":
268	            payloads = {
269	                "model": model_name,
270	                "input": disrm_prompt,
271	                "use_activation": False,
272	            }
273	            output = await self._post_request(payloads, "classify")
274	            rm_score = output["data"][-1]["probs"][-1]
275	        elif engine_name == "sglang":
276	            payloads = {
277	                "model": model_name,
278	                "input": disrm_prompt,
279	            }
280	            output = await self._post_request(payloads, "v1/embeddings")
281	            rm_score = output["data"][-1]["embedding"][-1]
282	        elif engine_name == "trtllm":
283	            # TODO: remove this once TRT-LLM switches to TorchSampler
284	            raise ValueError("TensorRT-LLM backend does not support reward models currently.")
285	
286	            payloads = {
287	                "model": model_name,
288	                "prompt": disrm_prompt,
289	                "return_context_logits": True,
290	            }
291	            output = await self._post_request(payloads, "v1/completions")
292	            rm_score = output["choices"][0]["context_logits"]
293	            assert isinstance(rm_score, list) and len(rm_score) > 0, (
294	                "TensorRT-LLM OpenAI server response for reward score is not in the expected format."
295	            )
296	
297	            rm_score = float(rm_score[0][0])
298	            logger.debug(f"rm score: {rm_score}")
299	        else:
300	            raise NotImplementedError(f"RewardLoopManager does not support {engine_name}")
301	
302	        return {"reward_score": rm_score}
303	
304	
305	class RewardLoopManager:
306	    """
307	    RewardLoopManager run in single controller.
308	    This class will create reward loop workers and manage them.
309	    """
310	
311	    def __init__(self, config: DictConfig, rm_resource_pool: RayResourcePool = None):
312	        self.config = config
313	        if self.config.reward.reward_model.enable:
314	            self.reward_model_manager = RewardModelManager(config.reward.reward_model, rm_resource_pool)
315	            self.reward_router_address = self.reward_model_manager.get_router_address()
316	        else:
317	            self.reward_model_manager = None
318	            self.reward_router_address = None
319	
320	        self.reward_loop_workers_class = ray.remote(RewardLoopWorker)
321	        self.reward_manager_cls = resolve_reward_manager_cls(config)
322	        self._init_reward_loop_workers()
323	
324	    @property
325	    def reward_loop_worker_handles(self) -> list[ActorHandle]:
326	        """Return worker handles for agent loop worker to compute reward score.
327	
328	        Only return worker handles when reward computation can be parallelized with rollout:
329	        (1) rule-based reward without reward model
330	        (2) reward model with extra resource pool
331	        """
332	        if not self.config.reward.reward_model.enable or self.config.reward.reward_model.enable_resource_pool:
333	            return self.reward_loop_workers
334	        return None
335	
336	    def _init_reward_loop_workers(self):
337	        self.reward_loop_workers = []
338	        num_workers = self.config.reward.num_workers
339	        node_ids = [node["NodeID"] for node in ray.nodes() if node["Alive"] and node["Resources"].get("CPU", 0) > 0]
340	
341	        for i in range(num_workers):
342	            # Round-robin scheduling over the all nodes
343	            node_id = node_ids[i % len(node_ids)]
344	
345	            self.reward_loop_workers.append(
346	                self.reward_loop_workers_class.options(
347	                    name=f"reward_loop_worker_{i}",
348	                    scheduling_strategy=ray.util.scheduling_strategies.NodeAffinitySchedulingStrategy(
349	                        node_id=node_id,
350	                        soft=True,
351	                    ),
352	                ).remote(self.config, self.reward_router_address)
353	            )
354	
355	    def compute_rm_score(self, data: DataProto) -> DataProto:
356	        if self.reward_model_manager is not None:
357	            self.reward_model_manager.wake_up()
358	
359	        num_workers = len(self.reward_loop_workers)
360	        padded_data, pad_size = pad_dataproto_to_divisor(data, num_workers)
361	        chunks = padded_data.chunk(num_workers)
362	        outputs = ray.get(
363	            [
364	                worker.compute_score_batch.remote(chunk)
365	                for worker, chunk in zip(self.reward_loop_workers, chunks, strict=True)
366	            ]
367	        )
368	        outputs_flat = [item for sublist in outputs for item in sublist]
369	        if pad_size > 0:
370	            outputs_flat = outputs_flat[: len(data)]
371	
372	        # compute rm score
373	        scores = [item["reward_score"] for item in outputs_flat]
374	        rm_scores = self.reward_manager_cls.assemble_rm_scores(data, scores)
375	        batch = TensorDict({"rm_scores": rm_scores}, batch_size=len(data))
376	
377	        reward_extra_infos = [output.get("reward_extra_info", {}) for output in outputs_flat]
378	        reward_extra_keys = list(reward_extra_infos[0].keys())
379	        non_tensor_batch = {}
380	        for key in reward_extra_keys:
381	            non_tensor_batch[key] = np.array([info[key] for info in reward_extra_infos], dtype=object)
382	
383	        if self.reward_model_manager is not None:
384	            self.reward_model_manager.sleep()
385	
386	        return DataProto(
387	            batch=batch, non_tensor_batch=non_tensor_batch, meta_info={"reward_extra_keys": reward_extra_keys}
388	        )
389	
390	    def _run_all(self, tasks: list[asyncio.Task]):
391	        async def run_all():
392	            return await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
393	
394	        return asyncio.run(run_all())

14	import logging
15	import os
16	from typing import Any
17	from uuid import uuid4
18	
19	from verl.experimental.agent_loop.agent_loop import AgentLoopBase, AgentLoopOutput, register
20	from verl.utils.profiler import simple_timer
21	from verl.utils.rollout_trace import rollout_trace_op

28	@register("single_turn_agent")
29	class SingleTurnAgentLoop(AgentLoopBase):
30	    """Naive agent loop that only do single turn chat completion."""
31	
32	    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
33	        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
34	        self.prompt_length = self.rollout_config.prompt_length
35	        self.response_length = self.rollout_config.response_length
36	
37	    @rollout_trace_op
38	    async def run(self, sampling_params: dict[str, Any], priority: int = 0, **kwargs) -> AgentLoopOutput:
39	        # priority may arrive as np.int64 from non_tensor_batch; normalize to Python int.
40	        priority = int(priority)
41	        messages = list(kwargs["raw_prompt"])
42	
43	        # 1. extract multimodal inputs from messages
44	        multi_modal_data = await self.process_multi_modal_info(messages)
45	        images = multi_modal_data.get("images")
46	        videos = multi_modal_data.get("videos")
47	        audios = multi_modal_data.get("audios")
48	        mm_processor_kwargs = self._get_mm_processor_kwargs(audios)
49	
50	        # 2. apply chat template and tokenize
51	        use_continuous_token = self.enable_continuous_token and not multi_modal_data
52	        if use_continuous_token:
53	            prompt_ids = await self.ct_build_initial_tokens(messages)
54	        else:
55	            prompt_ids = await self.apply_chat_template(
56	                messages,
57	                images=images,
58	                videos=videos,
59	                audios=audios,
60	                mm_processor_kwargs=mm_processor_kwargs,
61	            )
62	
63	        # 3. generate sequences
64	        metrics = {}
65	        with simple_timer("generate_sequences", metrics):
66	            request_id = f"det-{priority}" if getattr(self.rollout_config, "full_determinism", False) else uuid4().hex
67	            output: TokenOutput = await self.server_manager.generate(
68	                request_id=request_id,
69	                prompt_ids=prompt_ids,
70	                sampling_params=sampling_params,
71	                image_data=images,
72	                audio_data=audios,
73	                video_data=videos,
74	                mm_processor_kwargs=mm_processor_kwargs,
75	                priority=priority,
76	            )
77	        if metrics.get("num_preempted") is None:
78	            metrics["num_preempted"] = output.num_preempted if output.num_preempted is not None else -1
79	
80	        if use_continuous_token:
81	            merge_result, response_mask, response_logprobs = await self.ct_merge_assistant_token(
82	                prompt_ids,
83	                output.token_ids,
84	                [],
85	                [] if output.log_probs else None,
86	                assistant_logprobs=output.log_probs if output.log_probs else None,
87	            )
88	            response_ids = merge_result.token_ids[-len(response_mask) :] if response_mask else []
89	            prompt_ids = merge_result.token_ids[: len(merge_result.token_ids) - len(response_mask)]
90	        else:
91	            response_ids = output.token_ids
92	            response_mask = [1] * len(output.token_ids)
93	            response_logprobs = output.log_probs
94	
95	        output: AgentLoopOutput = AgentLoopOutput(
96	            prompt_ids=prompt_ids,
97	            response_ids=response_ids[: self.response_length],
98	            response_mask=response_mask[: self.response_length],
99	            response_logprobs=response_logprobs[: self.response_length] if response_logprobs else None,
100	            routed_experts=(
101	                output.routed_experts[: len(prompt_ids) + self.response_length]
102	                if output.routed_experts is not None
103	                else None
104	            ),
105	            multi_modal_data=multi_modal_data,
106	            mm_processor_kwargs=mm_processor_kwargs,
107	            num_turns=2,
108	            metrics=metrics,
109	            extra_fields=output.extra_fields,
110	        )
111	
112	        # keeping the schema consistent with tool_agent_loop
113	        output.extra_fields.update({"turn_scores": [], "tool_rewards": []})
114	
115	        return output

import logging
import os
from typing import Any
from uuid import uuid4

from verl.experimental.agent_loop.agent_loop import AgentLoopBase, AgentLoopOutput, register
from verl.utils.profiler import simple_timer
from verl.utils.rollout_trace import rollout_trace_op
from verl.workers.rollout.replica import TokenOutput

logger = logging.getLogger(__file__)
logger.setLevel(os.getenv("VERL_LOGGING_LEVEL", "WARN"))


@register("single_turn_agent")
class SingleTurnAgentLoop(AgentLoopBase):
    """Naive agent loop that only do single turn chat completion."""

    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        self.prompt_length = self.rollout_config.prompt_length
        self.response_length = self.rollout_config.response_length

    @rollout_trace_op
    async def run(self, sampling_params: dict[str, Any], priority: int = 0, **kwargs) -> AgentLoopOutput:
        # priority may arrive as np.int64 from non_tensor_batch; normalize to Python int.
        priority = int(priority)
        messages = list(kwargs["raw_prompt"])

        # 1. extract multimodal inputs from messages
        multi_modal_data = await self.process_multi_modal_info(messages)
        images = multi_modal_data.get("images")
        videos = multi_modal_data.get("videos")
        audios = multi_modal_data.get("audios")
        mm_processor_kwargs = self._get_mm_processor_kwargs(audios)

        # 2. apply chat template and tokenize
        use_continuous_token = self.enable_continuous_token and not multi_modal_data
        if use_continuous_token:
            prompt_ids = await self.ct_build_initial_tokens(messages)
        else:
            prompt_ids = await self.apply_chat_template(
                messages,
                images=images,
                videos=videos,
                audios=audios,
                mm_processor_kwargs=mm_processor_kwargs,
            )

        # 3. generate sequences
        metrics = {}
        with simple_timer("generate_sequences", metrics):
            request_id = f"det-{priority}" if getattr(self.rollout_config, "full_determinism", False) else uuid4().hex
            output: TokenOutput = await self.server_manager.generate(
                request_id=request_id,
                prompt_ids=prompt_ids,
                sampling_params=sampling_params,
                image_data=images,
                audio_data=audios,
                video_data=videos,
                mm_processor_kwargs=mm_processor_kwargs,
                priority=priority,
            )
        if metrics.get("num_preempted") is None:
            metrics["num_preempted"] = output.num_preempted if output.num_preempted is not None else -1

        if use_continuous_token:
            merge_result, response_mask, response_logprobs = await self.ct_merge_assistant_token(
                prompt_ids,
                output.token_ids,
                [],
                [] if output.log_probs else None,
                assistant_logprobs=output.log_probs if output.log_probs else None,
            )
            response_ids = merge_result.token_ids[-len(response_mask) :] if response_mask else []
            prompt_ids = merge_result.token_ids[: len(merge_result.token_ids) - len(response_mask)]
        else:
            response_ids = output.token_ids
            response_mask = [1] * len(output.token_ids)
            response_logprobs = output.log_probs

        output: AgentLoopOutput = AgentLoopOutput(
            prompt_ids=prompt_ids,
            response_ids=response_ids[: self.response_length],
            response_mask=response_mask[: self.response_length],
            response_logprobs=response_logprobs[: self.response_length] if response_logprobs else None,
            routed_experts=(
                output.routed_experts[: len(prompt_ids) + self.response_length]
                if output.routed_experts is not None
                else None
            ),
            multi_modal_data=multi_modal_data,
            mm_processor_kwargs=mm_processor_kwargs,
            num_turns=2,
            metrics=metrics,
            extra_fields=output.extra_fields,
        )

        # keeping the schema consistent with tool_agent_loop
        output.extra_fields.update({"turn_scores": [], "tool_rewards": []})

        return output

    loss_name = name

1138	def agg_loss(
1139	    loss_mat: torch.Tensor,
1140	    loss_mask: torch.Tensor,
1141	    loss_agg_mode: str,
1142	    dp_size: int = 1,
1143	    batch_num_tokens: Optional[int] = None,
1144	    global_batch_size: Optional[int] = None,
1145	    loss_scale_factor: Optional[int] = None,
1146	):
1147	    """
1148	    Aggregate the loss across global batch to ensure the loss is invariant to fsdp/megatron parallelism.
1149	
1150	    NOTE: The returned loss has different behaviors for different backend:
1151	    - FSDP: the loss is directly used for backward.
1152	    - Megatron: the loss should be scaled by `num_microbatches` and `cp_size` for pp schedule.
1153	
1154	    Args:
1155	        loss_mat: micro batch loss matrix, (bs, response_length)
1156	        loss_mask: micro batch loss mask, (bs, response_length)
1157	        loss_agg_mode: method to aggregate the loss matrix into a scalar
1158	        dp_size: data parallel size
1159	        batch_num_tokens: number of valid tokens in global batch
1160	        global_batch_size: global batch size
1161	        loss_scale_factor: scale factor for "seq-mean-token-sum-norm" mode. If None, uses loss_mask.shape[-1].
1162	            Set this to a constant value to ensure consistent normalization throughout training.
1163	
1164	    Returns:
1165	        loss: `a scalar torch.Tensor`
1166	            aggregated loss
1167	    """
1168	    if loss_agg_mode == "token-mean":
1169	        if batch_num_tokens is None:
1170	            if dp_size > 1:
1171	                raise ValueError("(global) batch_num_tokens is required when dp_size > 1")
1172	            batch_num_tokens = loss_mask.sum()
1173	        loss = verl_F.masked_sum(loss_mat, loss_mask) / batch_num_tokens * dp_size
1174	    elif loss_agg_mode in ["seq-mean-token-sum", "seq-mean-token-sum-norm"]:
1175	        seq_losses = torch.sum(loss_mat * loss_mask, dim=-1)  # token-sum
1176	        seq_mask = (torch.sum(loss_mask, dim=-1) > 0).float()  # exclude fully masked sequences
1177	        if global_batch_size is None:
1178	            if dp_size > 1:
1179	                raise ValueError("global_batch_size is required when dp_size > 1")
1180	            global_batch_size = seq_mask.sum()
1181	        loss = verl_F.masked_sum(seq_losses, seq_mask) / global_batch_size * dp_size  # seq-mean
1182	        if loss_agg_mode == "seq-mean-token-sum-norm":
1183	            if loss_scale_factor is None:
1184	                horizon = loss_mask.shape[-1]
1185	                loss_scale_factor = horizon
1186	            loss /= loss_scale_factor
1187	    elif loss_agg_mode == "seq-mean-token-mean":
1188	        seq_mask = torch.sum(loss_mask, dim=-1)  # per-sequence token count
1189	        seq_losses = torch.sum(loss_mat * loss_mask, dim=-1) / (seq_mask + 1e-8)  # token-mean
1190	        seq_mask = (seq_mask > 0).float()  # exclude fully masked sequences
1191	        if global_batch_size is None:
1192	            if dp_size > 1:
1193	                raise ValueError("global_batch_size is required when dp_size > 1")
1194	            global_batch_size = seq_mask.sum()
1195	        loss = verl_F.masked_sum(seq_losses, seq_mask) / global_batch_size * dp_size  # seq-mean
1196	    else:
1197	        raise ValueError(f"Invalid loss_agg_mode: {loss_agg_mode}")
1198	
1199	    return loss

1203	def compute_policy_loss(
1204	    old_log_prob,
1205	    log_prob,
1206	    advantages,
1207	    response_mask,
1208	    cliprange=None,
1209	    cliprange_low=None,
1210	    cliprange_high=None,
1211	    clip_ratio_c=3.0,
1212	    loss_agg_mode: str = "token-mean",
1213	):
1214	    """
1215	    Compute the clipped policy objective and related metrics for PPO.
1216	
1217	    Adapted from
1218	    https://github.com/huggingface/trl/blob/main/trl/trainer/ppo_trainer.py#L1122
1219	
1220	    Args:
1221	        old_log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1222	            Log-probabilities of actions under the old policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1223	        log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1224	            Log-probabilities of actions under the current policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1225	        advantages (torch.Tensor):
1226	            Advantage estimates for each action, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1227	        response_mask (torch.Tensor):
1228	            Mask indicating which tokens to include in the loss, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1229	        cliprange (float, optional):
1230	            Clipping parameter ε for standard PPO. See https://arxiv.org/abs/1707.06347.
1231	            Defaults to None (must be provided).
1232	        cliprange_low (float, optional):
1233	            Lower clip range for dual-clip PPO. Defaults to same as `cliprange`.
1234	        cliprange_high (float, optional):
1235	            Upper clip range for dual-clip PPO. Defaults to same as `cliprange`.
1236	        clip_ratio_c (float, optional):
1237	            Lower bound of the ratio for dual-clip PPO. See https://arxiv.org/pdf/1912.09729.
1238	            Defaults to 3.0.
1239	        loss_agg_mode (str, optional):
1240	            Aggregation mode for `agg_loss`. Defaults to "token-mean".
1241	    """
1242	    assert clip_ratio_c > 1.0, (
1243	        "The lower bound of the clip_ratio_c for dual-clip PPO should be greater than 1.0,"
1244	        + f" but get the value: {clip_ratio_c}."
1245	    )
1246	
1247	    negative_approx_kl = log_prob - old_log_prob
1248	    # Clamp negative_approx_kl for stability
1249	    negative_approx_kl = torch.clamp(negative_approx_kl, min=-20.0, max=20.0)
1250	    ratio = torch.exp(negative_approx_kl)
1251	    ppo_kl = verl_F.masked_mean(-negative_approx_kl, response_mask)
1252	
1253	    pg_losses1 = -advantages * ratio
1254	    if cliprange_low is None:
1255	        cliprange_low = cliprange
1256	    if cliprange_high is None:
1257	        cliprange_high = cliprange
1258	    pg_losses2 = -advantages * torch.clamp(
1259	        ratio, 1 - cliprange_low, 1 + cliprange_high
1260	    )  # - clip(ratio, 1-cliprange, 1+cliprange) * A
1261	    clip_pg_losses1 = torch.maximum(
1262	        pg_losses1, pg_losses2
1263	    )  # max(-ratio * A, -clip(ratio, 1-cliprange, 1+cliprange) * A)
1264	    pg_clipfrac = verl_F.masked_mean(torch.gt(pg_losses2, pg_losses1).float(), response_mask)
1265	
1266	    pg_losses3 = -advantages * clip_ratio_c
1267	    clip_pg_losses2 = torch.min(pg_losses3, clip_pg_losses1)
1268	    pg_clipfrac_lower = verl_F.masked_mean(
1269	        torch.gt(clip_pg_losses1, pg_losses3) * (advantages < 0).float(), response_mask
1270	    )
1271	
1272	    pg_losses = torch.where(advantages < 0, clip_pg_losses2, clip_pg_losses1)
1273	    pg_loss = agg_loss(loss_mat=pg_losses, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode=loss_agg_mode)
1274	
1275	    return pg_loss, pg_clipfrac, ppo_kl, pg_clipfrac_lower

def agg_loss(
    loss_mat: torch.Tensor,
    loss_mask: torch.Tensor,
    loss_agg_mode: str,
    dp_size: int = 1,
    batch_num_tokens: Optional[int] = None,
    global_batch_size: Optional[int] = None,
    loss_scale_factor: Optional[int] = None,
):
    """
    Aggregate the loss across global batch to ensure the loss is invariant to fsdp/megatron parallelism.

    NOTE: The returned loss has different behaviors for different backend:
    - FSDP: the loss is directly used for backward.
    - Megatron: the loss should be scaled by `num_microbatches` and `cp_size` for pp schedule.

    Args:
        loss_mat: micro batch loss matrix, (bs, response_length)
        loss_mask: micro batch loss mask, (bs, response_length)
        loss_agg_mode: method to aggregate the loss matrix into a scalar
        dp_size: data parallel size
        batch_num_tokens: number of valid tokens in global batch
        global_batch_size: global batch size
        loss_scale_factor: scale factor for "seq-mean-token-sum-norm" mode. If None, uses loss_mask.shape[-1].
            Set this to a constant value to ensure consistent normalization throughout training.

    Returns:
        loss: `a scalar torch.Tensor`
            aggregated loss
    """
    if loss_agg_mode == "token-mean":
        if batch_num_tokens is None:
            if dp_size > 1:
                raise ValueError("(global) batch_num_tokens is required when dp_size > 1")
            batch_num_tokens = loss_mask.sum()
        loss = verl_F.masked_sum(loss_mat, loss_mask) / batch_num_tokens * dp_size
    elif loss_agg_mode in ["seq-mean-token-sum", "seq-mean-token-sum-norm"]:
        seq_losses = torch.sum(loss_mat * loss_mask, dim=-1)  # token-sum
        seq_mask = (torch.sum(loss_mask, dim=-1) > 0).float()  # exclude fully masked sequences
        if global_batch_size is None:
            if dp_size > 1:
                raise ValueError("global_batch_size is required when dp_size > 1")
            global_batch_size = seq_mask.sum()
        loss = verl_F.masked_sum(seq_losses, seq_mask) / global_batch_size * dp_size  # seq-mean
        if loss_agg_mode == "seq-mean-token-sum-norm":
            if loss_scale_factor is None:
                horizon = loss_mask.shape[-1]
                loss_scale_factor = horizon
            loss /= loss_scale_factor
    elif loss_agg_mode == "seq-mean-token-mean":
        seq_mask = torch.sum(loss_mask, dim=-1)  # per-sequence token count
        seq_losses = torch.sum(loss_mat * loss_mask, dim=-1) / (seq_mask + 1e-8)  # token-mean
        seq_mask = (seq_mask > 0).float()  # exclude fully masked sequences
        if global_batch_size is None:
            if dp_size > 1:
                raise ValueError("global_batch_size is required when dp_size > 1")
            global_batch_size = seq_mask.sum()
        loss = verl_F.masked_sum(seq_losses, seq_mask) / global_batch_size * dp_size  # seq-mean
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid loss_agg_mode: {loss_agg_mode}")

    return loss


@deprecated("verl.trainer.ppo.core_algos.compute_policy_loss_vanilla")
def compute_policy_loss(
    old_log_prob,
    log_prob,
    advantages,
    response_mask,
    cliprange=None,
    cliprange_low=None,
    cliprange_high=None,
    clip_ratio_c=3.0,
    loss_agg_mode: str = "token-mean",
):
    """
    Compute the clipped policy objective and related metrics for PPO.

    Adapted from
    https://github.com/huggingface/trl/blob/main/trl/trainer/ppo_trainer.py#L1122

    Args:
        old_log_prob (torch.Tensor):
            Log-probabilities of actions under the old policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
        log_prob (torch.Tensor):
            Log-probabilities of actions under the current policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
        advantages (torch.Tensor):
            Advantage estimates for each action, shape (batch_size, response_length).
        response_mask (torch.Tensor):
            Mask indicating which tokens to include in the loss, shape (batch_size, response_length).
        cliprange (float, optional):
            Clipping parameter ε for standard PPO. See https://arxiv.org/abs/1707.06347.
            Defaults to None (must be provided).
        cliprange_low (float, optional):
            Lower clip range for dual-clip PPO. Defaults to same as `cliprange`.
        cliprange_high (float, optional):
            Upper clip range for dual-clip PPO. Defaults to same as `cliprange`.
        clip_ratio_c (float, optional):
            Lower bound of the ratio for dual-clip PPO. See https://arxiv.org/pdf/1912.09729.
            Defaults to 3.0.
        loss_agg_mode (str, optional):
            Aggregation mode for `agg_loss`. Defaults to "token-mean".
    """
    assert clip_ratio_c > 1.0, (
        "The lower bound of the clip_ratio_c for dual-clip PPO should be greater than 1.0,"
        + f" but get the value: {clip_ratio_c}."
    )

    negative_approx_kl = log_prob - old_log_prob
    # Clamp negative_approx_kl for stability
    negative_approx_kl = torch.clamp(negative_approx_kl, min=-20.0, max=20.0)
    ratio = torch.exp(negative_approx_kl)
    ppo_kl = verl_F.masked_mean(-negative_approx_kl, response_mask)

    pg_losses1 = -advantages * ratio
    if cliprange_low is None:
        cliprange_low = cliprange
    if cliprange_high is None:
        cliprange_high = cliprange
    pg_losses2 = -advantages * torch.clamp(
        ratio, 1 - cliprange_low, 1 + cliprange_high
    )  # - clip(ratio, 1-cliprange, 1+cliprange) * A
    clip_pg_losses1 = torch.maximum(
        pg_losses1, pg_losses2
    )  # max(-ratio * A, -clip(ratio, 1-cliprange, 1+cliprange) * A)
    pg_clipfrac = verl_F.masked_mean(torch.gt(pg_losses2, pg_losses1).float(), response_mask)

    pg_losses3 = -advantages * clip_ratio_c
    clip_pg_losses2 = torch.min(pg_losses3, clip_pg_losses1)
    pg_clipfrac_lower = verl_F.masked_mean(
        torch.gt(clip_pg_losses1, pg_losses3) * (advantages < 0).float(), response_mask
    )

    pg_losses = torch.where(advantages < 0, clip_pg_losses2, clip_pg_losses1)
    pg_loss = agg_loss(loss_mat=pg_losses, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode=loss_agg_mode)

    return pg_loss, pg_clipfrac, ppo_kl, pg_clipfrac_lower


@register_policy_loss("vanilla")  # type: ignore[arg-type]
def compute_policy_loss_vanilla(
    old_log_prob: torch.Tensor,
    log_prob: torch.Tensor,
    advantages: torch.Tensor,
    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
    loss_agg_mode: str = "token-mean",
    config: Optional[ActorConfig] = None,
    rollout_is_weights: torch.Tensor | None = None,
) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Compute the clipped policy objective and related metrics for PPO.

    Adapted from
    https://github.com/huggingface/trl/blob/main/trl/trainer/ppo_trainer.py#L1122

    Args:
        old_log_prob (torch.Tensor):
            Log-probabilities of actions under the old policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
        log_prob (torch.Tensor):
            Log-probabilities of actions under the current policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
        advantages (torch.Tensor):
            Advantage estimates for each action, shape (batch_size, response_length).
        response_mask (torch.Tensor):
            Mask indicating which tokens to include in the loss, shape (batch_size, response_length).
        loss_agg_mode (str, optional):
            Aggregation mode for `agg_loss`. Defaults to "token-mean".
        config: `(verl.trainer.config.ActorConfig)`:
            config for the actor.
        rollout_log_probs: `(torch.Tensor)`:
            log probabilities of actions under the rollout policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
    """

    assert config is not None
    assert not isinstance(config, AlgoConfig)
    clip_ratio = config.clip_ratio  # Clipping parameter ε for standard PPO. See https://arxiv.org/abs/1707.06347.
    clip_ratio_low = config.clip_ratio_low if config.clip_ratio_low is not None else clip_ratio
    clip_ratio_high = config.clip_ratio_high if config.clip_ratio_high is not None else clip_ratio
    clip_ratio_c = config.get(  # Lower bound of the ratio for dual-clip PPO. See https://arxiv.org/pdf/1912.09729.
        "clip_ratio_c", 3.0
    )

    cliprange = clip_ratio
    cliprange_low = clip_ratio_low
    cliprange_high = clip_ratio_high

    assert clip_ratio_c > 1.0, (
        "The lower bound of the clip_ratio_c for dual-clip PPO should be greater than 1.0,"
        + f" but get the value: {clip_ratio_c}."
    )

    negative_approx_kl = log_prob - old_log_prob
    # Clamp negative_approx_kl for stability
    negative_approx_kl = torch.clamp(negative_approx_kl, min=-20.0, max=20.0)
    ratio = torch.exp(negative_approx_kl)
    ppo_kl = verl_F.masked_mean(-negative_approx_kl, response_mask)

    pg_losses1 = -advantages * ratio
    if cliprange_low is None:
        cliprange_low = cliprange
    if cliprange_high is None:
        cliprange_high = cliprange
    pg_losses2 = -advantages * torch.clamp(
        ratio, 1 - cliprange_low, 1 + cliprange_high
    )  # - clip(ratio, 1-cliprange, 1+cliprange) * A
    clip_pg_losses1 = torch.maximum(
        pg_losses1, pg_losses2
    )  # max(-ratio * A, -clip(ratio, 1-cliprange, 1+cliprange) * A)
    pg_clipfrac = verl_F.masked_mean(torch.gt(pg_losses2, pg_losses1).float(), response_mask)

    pg_losses3 = -advantages * clip_ratio_c
    clip_pg_losses2 = torch.min(pg_losses3, clip_pg_losses1)
    pg_clipfrac_lower = verl_F.masked_mean(
        torch.gt(clip_pg_losses1, pg_losses3) * (advantages < 0).float(), response_mask
    )

    pg_losses = torch.where(advantages < 0, clip_pg_losses2, clip_pg_losses1)

    # Apply rollout correction weights if provided
    if rollout_is_weights is not None:
        pg_losses = pg_losses * rollout_is_weights

    pg_loss = agg_loss(
        loss_mat=pg_losses, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode=loss_agg_mode, **config.global_batch_info
    )

    pg_metrics = {
        "actor/pg_clipfrac": pg_clipfrac.detach().item(),
        "actor/ppo_kl": ppo_kl.detach().item(),
        "actor/pg_clipfrac_lower": pg_clipfrac_lower.detach().item(),
    }
    return pg_loss, pg_metrics

1272	    pg_losses = torch.where(advantages < 0, clip_pg_losses2, clip_pg_losses1)
1273	    pg_loss = agg_loss(loss_mat=pg_losses, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode=loss_agg_mode)
1274	
1275	    return pg_loss, pg_clipfrac, ppo_kl, pg_clipfrac_lower
1276

1278	@register_policy_loss("vanilla")  # type: ignore[arg-type]
1279	def compute_policy_loss_vanilla(
1280	    old_log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1281	    log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1282	    advantages: torch.Tensor,
1283	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
1284	    loss_agg_mode: str = "token-mean",
1285	    config: Optional[ActorConfig] = None,
1286	    rollout_is_weights: torch.Tensor | None = None,
1287	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict[str, Any]]:
1288	    """
1289	    Compute the clipped policy objective and related metrics for PPO.
1290	
1291	    Adapted from
1292	    https://github.com/huggingface/trl/blob/main/trl/trainer/ppo_trainer.py#L1122
1293	
1294	    Args:
1295	        old_log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1296	            Log-probabilities of actions under the old policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1297	        log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1298	            Log-probabilities of actions under the current policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1299	        advantages (torch.Tensor):
1300	            Advantage estimates for each action, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1301	        response_mask (torch.Tensor):
1302	            Mask indicating which tokens to include in the loss, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1303	        loss_agg_mode (str, optional):
1304	            Aggregation mode for `agg_loss`. Defaults to "token-mean".
1305	        config: `(verl.trainer.config.ActorConfig)`:
1306	            config for the actor.
1307	        rollout_log_probs: `(torch.Tensor)`:
1308	            log probabilities of actions under the rollout policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1309	    """
1310	
1311	    assert config is not None
1312	    assert not isinstance(config, AlgoConfig)
1313	    clip_ratio = config.clip_ratio  # Clipping parameter ε for standard PPO. See https://arxiv.org/abs/1707.06347.
1314	    clip_ratio_low = config.clip_ratio_low if config.clip_ratio_low is not None else clip_ratio
1315	    clip_ratio_high = config.clip_ratio_high if config.clip_ratio_high is not None else clip_ratio
1316	    clip_ratio_c = config.get(  # Lower bound of the ratio for dual-clip PPO. See https://arxiv.org/pdf/1912.09729.
1317	        "clip_ratio_c", 3.0
1318	    )
1319	
1320	    cliprange = clip_ratio
1321	    cliprange_low = clip_ratio_low
1322	    cliprange_high = clip_ratio_high
1323	
1324	    assert clip_ratio_c > 1.0, (
1325	        "The lower bound of the clip_ratio_c for dual-clip PPO should be greater than 1.0,"
1326	        + f" but get the value: {clip_ratio_c}."
1327	    )
1328	
1329	    negative_approx_kl = log_prob - old_log_prob
1330	    # Clamp negative_approx_kl for stability
1331	    negative_approx_kl = torch.clamp(negative_approx_kl, min=-20.0, max=20.0)
1332	    ratio = torch.exp(negative_approx_kl)
1333	    ppo_kl = verl_F.masked_mean(-negative_approx_kl, response_mask)
1334	
1335	    pg_losses1 = -advantages * ratio
1336	    if cliprange_low is None:
1337	        cliprange_low = cliprange
1338	    if cliprange_high is None:
1339	        cliprange_high = cliprange
1340	    pg_losses2 = -advantages * torch.clamp(
1341	        ratio, 1 - cliprange_low, 1 + cliprange_high
1342	    )  # - clip(ratio, 1-cliprange, 1+cliprange) * A
1343	    clip_pg_losses1 = torch.maximum(
1344	        pg_losses1, pg_losses2
1345	    )  # max(-ratio * A, -clip(ratio, 1-cliprange, 1+cliprange) * A)
1346	    pg_clipfrac = verl_F.masked_mean(torch.gt(pg_losses2, pg_losses1).float(), response_mask)
1347	
1348	    pg_losses3 = -advantages * clip_ratio_c
1349	    clip_pg_losses2 = torch.min(pg_losses3, clip_pg_losses1)
1350	    pg_clipfrac_lower = verl_F.masked_mean(
1351	        torch.gt(clip_pg_losses1, pg_losses3) * (advantages < 0).float(), response_mask
1352	    )
1353	
1354	    pg_losses = torch.where(advantages < 0, clip_pg_losses2, clip_pg_losses1)
1355	
1356	    # Apply rollout correction weights if provided
1357	    if rollout_is_weights is not None:
1358	        pg_losses = pg_losses * rollout_is_weights
1359	
1360	    pg_loss = agg_loss(
1361	        loss_mat=pg_losses, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode=loss_agg_mode, **config.global_batch_info
1362	    )
1363	
1364	    pg_metrics = {
1365	        "actor/pg_clipfrac": pg_clipfrac.detach().item(),
1366	        "actor/ppo_kl": ppo_kl.detach().item(),
1367	        "actor/pg_clipfrac_lower": pg_clipfrac_lower.detach().item(),
1368	    }
1369	    return pg_loss, pg_metrics

19	from verl.trainer.ppo.core_algos import agg_loss, compute_value_loss, get_policy_loss_fn, kl_penalty
20	from verl.utils import tensordict_utils as tu

28	def sft_loss(config: ActorConfig, model_output, data: TensorDict, dp_group=None):
29	    pad_mode = tu.get_non_tensor_data(data=data, key="pad_mode", default=DatasetPadMode.NO_PADDING)
30	    dp_size = data["dp_size"]
31	    batch_num_tokens = data["batch_num_tokens"]
32	
33	    log_prob = model_output["log_probs"]
34	
35	    if pad_mode == DatasetPadMode.NO_PADDING:
36	        # log_prob and loss mask are nested tensors of shape [bsz, j1]
37	        # for each sample, loss mask shape is [1, prompt_length + response_length]
38	        loss_mask = data["loss_mask"]
39	
40	        log_prob_flatten = log_prob.values()
41	        loss_mask_flatten = loss_mask.values()
42	
43	        # left-shift the loss mask by one token to align with log_prob
44	        loss_mask_flatten = torch.roll(loss_mask_flatten, shifts=-1, dims=0)
45	
46	        # NOTE: loss is averaged over all tokens in the batch across all data parallel groups,
47	        # For FSDP backend, the loss is directly used for backward; while for Megatron backend,
48	        # the loss should be scaled by `num_microbatches` for pp schedule.
49	        loss = -masked_sum(log_prob_flatten, loss_mask_flatten) / batch_num_tokens * dp_size
50	    else:
51	        response_mask = data["response_mask"].to(bool)
52	        loss = -masked_sum(log_prob, response_mask) / batch_num_tokens * dp_size
53	
54	    return loss, {}
55

57	def ppo_loss(config: ActorConfig, model_output, data: TensorDict, dp_group=None):
58	    """Computes ppo loss from model output (log_prob, entropy, values, etc. ) and old_log_probs from data."""
59	    log_prob = no_padding_2_padding(model_output["log_probs"], data)
60	    entropy = model_output.get("entropy", None)
61	    if entropy is not None:
62	        entropy = no_padding_2_padding(entropy, data)
63	
64	    # global batch info for loss aggregation
65	    config.global_batch_info["dp_size"] = data["dp_size"]
66	    config.global_batch_info["batch_num_tokens"] = data["batch_num_tokens"]
67	    config.global_batch_info["global_batch_size"] = data["global_batch_size"]
68	    config.global_batch_info["loss_scale_factor"] = config.loss_scale_factor
69	
70	    # assumes that if any of the global batch info is set, the policy_loss_fn will
71	    # normalize using dp_size/global_bsz/global_token; in this case, metric aggregation should be SUM
72	    # to reflect the mean loss over the global batch
73	    if (
74	        data["dp_size"] > 1
75	        or data["batch_num_tokens"] is not None
76	        or data["global_batch_size"] is not None
77	        or config.loss_scale_factor is not None
78	    ):
79	        metric_aggregation = AggregationType.SUM
80	    else:
81	        metric_aggregation = AggregationType.MEAN
82	
83	    metrics = {}
84	
85	    # select fields and convert to padded tensor
86	    fields = ["response_mask", "old_log_probs", "advantages"]
87	    if "rollout_is_weights" in data:
88	        fields.append("rollout_is_weights")
89	    if "ref_log_prob" in data:
90	        fields.append("ref_log_prob")
91	    data = data.select(*fields).to_padded_tensor()
92	
93	    response_mask = data["response_mask"].to(bool)
94	    # compute policy loss
95	    old_log_prob = data["old_log_probs"]
96	    advantages = data["advantages"]
97	    rollout_is_weights = data.get("rollout_is_weights", None)
98	
99	    loss_agg_mode = config.loss_agg_mode
100	
101	    loss_mode = config.policy_loss.get("loss_mode", "vanilla")
102	
103	    policy_loss_fn = get_policy_loss_fn(loss_mode)
104	    pg_loss, pg_metrics = policy_loss_fn(
105	        old_log_prob=old_log_prob,
106	        log_prob=log_prob,
107	        advantages=advantages,
108	        response_mask=response_mask,
109	        loss_agg_mode=loss_agg_mode,
110	        config=config,
111	        rollout_is_weights=rollout_is_weights,
112	    )
113	
114	    # AggregationType.MEAN for pg metrics: assumes policy_loss_fn normalizes by local_bsz/local_tokens
115	    # Ex: in compute_policy_loss_vanilla, pg_metrics are pg_clipfrac, ppo_kl, pg_clipfrac_lower
116	    pg_metrics = Metric.from_dict(pg_metrics, aggregation=AggregationType.MEAN)
117	
118	    metrics.update(pg_metrics)
119	    metrics["actor/pg_loss"] = Metric(value=pg_loss, aggregation=metric_aggregation)
120	    policy_loss = pg_loss
121	
122	    # add entropy loss
123	    if entropy is not None:
124	        entropy_loss = agg_loss(
125	            loss_mat=entropy, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode=loss_agg_mode, **config.global_batch_info
126	        )
127	        entropy_coeff = config.entropy_coeff
128	        policy_loss -= entropy_coeff * entropy_loss
129	        metrics["actor/entropy_loss"] = Metric(value=entropy_loss, aggregation=metric_aggregation)
130	
131	    # add kl loss
132	    if config.use_kl_loss:
133	        ref_log_prob = data["ref_log_prob"]
134	        # compute kl loss
135	        kld = kl_penalty(logprob=log_prob, ref_logprob=ref_log_prob, kl_penalty=config.kl_loss_type)
136	        kl_loss = agg_loss(
137	            loss_mat=kld, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode=config.loss_agg_mode, **config.global_batch_info
138	        )
139	
140	        policy_loss += kl_loss * config.kl_loss_coef
141	        metrics["kl_loss"] = Metric(value=kl_loss, aggregation=metric_aggregation)
142	        metrics["kl_coef"] = config.kl_loss_coef
143	
144	    return policy_loss, metrics

147	def value_loss(config: CriticConfig, model_output, data: TensorDict, dp_group=None):
148	    """value loss
149	
150	    Args:
151	        config: CriticConfig
152	        model_output: model output from the model
153	        data: the input to the model
154	        dp_group: data paralle group
155	
156	    Returns:
157	        value loss
158	    """
159	    vpreds = no_padding_2_padding(model_output["values"], data)  # (bsz, response_length)
160	
161	    # Normalize the value loss over the global mini-batch (dp_size / batch_num_tokens /
162	    # global_batch_size) instead of the local micro-batch, so the accumulated critic gradient is
163	    # invariant to how the mini-batch is split into micro-batches (as the actor's ppo_loss does).
164	    dp_size = data["dp_size"]
165	    batch_num_tokens = data["batch_num_tokens"]
166	    global_batch_size = data["global_batch_size"]
167	
168	    # When the loss is normalized over the global batch, each micro-batch contributes a partial sum,
169	    # so the loss metric must be aggregated with SUM to reflect the global-batch mean.
170	    if (
171	        dp_size > 1
172	        or batch_num_tokens is not None
173	        or global_batch_size is not None
174	        or config.loss_scale_factor is not None
175	    ):
176	        metric_aggregation = AggregationType.SUM
177	    else:
178	        metric_aggregation = AggregationType.MEAN
179	
180	    # select fields and convert to padded tensor
181	    data = data.select("values", "returns", "response_mask").to_padded_tensor()
182	    values = data["values"]
183	    returns = data["returns"]
184	    response_mask = data["response_mask"].to(bool)
185	
186	    vf_loss, vf_clipfrac = compute_value_loss(
187	        vpreds=vpreds,
188	        values=values,
189	        returns=returns,
190	        response_mask=response_mask,
191	        cliprange_value=config.cliprange_value,
192	        loss_agg_mode=config.loss_agg_mode,
193	        dp_size=dp_size,
194	        batch_num_tokens=batch_num_tokens,
195	        global_batch_size=global_batch_size,
196	        loss_scale_factor=config.loss_scale_factor,
197	    )
198	
199	    metrics = {
200	        "critic/vf_loss": Metric(value=vf_loss, aggregation=metric_aggregation),
201	        "critic/vf_clipfrac": vf_clipfrac.detach().item(),
202	        "critic/vpred_mean": masked_mean(vpreds, response_mask).detach().item(),
203	    }
204	
205	    return vf_loss, metrics
